atoms.law: Unsigned UTF-8 byte lexicographic order equals Unicode scalar order for well-formed scalars; consume the original UTF-16 stream without allocating encoded arrays.
Each unpaired surrogate is compared as '?' to retain the existing String.getBytes(UTF_8) replacement behavior. A valid pair consumes two units.
After all compared scalars agree, the exhausted input sorts before a remaining suffix; return only -1, 0 or 1 like the old comparator.
Keep all original source/revision/fingerprint/normalization fields, immutable public views, rejection behavior and reverse-view ordering.
Admit exactly M3InstanceIndexPrecompute.java through existing hash-pinned AST recipe; neighbors, traversal, duplicate/missing/drifted source refuse.

generation.classification: Bounded private implementation maintenance under existing API; no new runtime owner. New-runtime generation lane remains held while Chrome local AI is unavailable.

lanes: UnicodeX JNI stable-input parity and ownership source review

measurements: Fixed rounds on Java21.0.9 Windows, not a statistical or cross-platform performance guarantee; public lookup still allocates.
